newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Sept industrial price index rises 0.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada Sept industrial price index rises 0.2 pct.

text.p: Statistics Canada on Tuesday issued the following economic indicators for September.
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT PRICE INDEX Month-on-Month Year-on-Year
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT PRICE INDEX Month-on-Month Year-on-Year
The IPPI reflects the prices producers receive as goods leave their plants.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast that the overall index would rise 0.4 percent in September from August.
